releases.title: Brand Regeneration and Validation Fit Hotfix
releases.summary: Ensures two-label Brand Recipes regenerate immediately and keeps the top Validation status card within the panel width.
changes: Apply dimension-driven label station rules whenever a Brand Recipe is selected.
Regenerate and persist the Servo Program before rerendering Validation.
Stack Validation status, faults, warnings, checks, and duplicate counts in one constrained column.
Refresh release and feature cache keys so browsers do not reuse the 0.9.9 behavior.

releases.title: Workspace Navigation and Developer Controls
releases.summary: Moves Map Builder into the primary workspace tabs and adds locally authenticated developer controls for panel visibility and read-only map locking.
changes: Order the primary navigation as Map Builder, Specs, Build Inputs, Servo Program, Servo Simulation, and Diagnostics.
Close Settings, Map Builder, map-reference, wipe-data, and open builder detail panels when the user clicks outside them.
Create a first-use Developer Mode login with locally hashed credentials and session-only unlocking.
Allow Developer Mode to hide or restore operator panels without modifying saved map data.
Allow selected maps to be locked and loaded from a Locked Maps dropdown in read-only mode.
Hide Map Builder and disable specification, Build Input, Servo Program, and direct map editing while a locked map is active.

releases.title: Production Hardening, Release Readiness, and Incremental Profile Generation
releases.summary: Adds operator-run release checks and a constrained Incremental Rotations profile generator that can distribute equivalent bottle orientation across multiple safe TopModul CMD 7 stages.
changes: Run Release Check from Settings and export the complete JSON report.
Validate application version metadata, loaded asset versions, update manifest destination, and critical published assets.
Validate saved maps, blank templates, bottle specs, label specs, settings JSON round-trip, browser storage, and CSV export shape.
Run built-in TopModul, Autocol, replay determinism, and non-destructive optimizer regressions.
Prepare and verify a complete offline application cache without changing operator data.
Keep current-setup servo faults visible as configuration review items rather than hiding them from release checks.
Generate Incremental Rotations across multiple CMD 7 stages instead of forcing an equivalent orientation into one short table window.
Require inside wipe-down support on both enabled members of an aggregate pair before continuing rotation out of the wipe-down.
Convert only eligible wipe-complete CMD 3 references into continued correction stages; application, sensor, coding, terminal, Autocol, and manually overridden references remain protected.
Borrow only verified downstream table travel before the next protected mechanical boundary and insert additional setpoints when a single correction stage would be too large.

Reject the complete candidate unless table angles remain increasing, every CMD 7 moves the bottle below the configured speed limit, the final orientation remains physically equivalent, TopModul grammar passes, and the program still closes at CMD 3 Rest.

releases.title: Program Diagnostics and Optimization
releases.summary: Adds diagnostics for correction speed, short motion windows, duplicate actions, redundant references, wipe contact, and uneven correction-chain timing.
changes: Show current program metrics and recommendations in Servo Program.
Generate only validated timing candidates that stay inside mechanical contact windows.
Load optimization candidates into custom Servo Simulation without modifying generated production rows.
Restore the previous custom simulation after comparison.

releases.title: Authoritative TopModul Chain Validation
releases.summary: Makes the selected machine type authoritative at the final validation boundary.
changes: Accept TopModul CMD 3 to one-or-more CMD 7 to CMD 3 correction chains.
Remove obsolete immediate 3-7-3 errors from the final Validation panel.
Preserve speed, motion, planner, translation, table-order, and terminal safety checks.

releases.title: TopModul Double Corrections
releases.summary: Allows safe consecutive TopModul correction moves for label backspin and reverse-wipe stages.
changes: Keep Autocol referenced-pair rules separate.
Require every TopModul correction to produce bottle movement and eventually close at CMD 3.

releases.title: Machine-Specific Terminal Policy
releases.summary: Separates TopModul final Rest behavior from the Autocol End of curve boundary.
changes: Finish TopModul at the final CMD 3 Rest reference, including Hold for Coding.
Keep Autocol End of curve at 359 degrees.

releases.title: Servo Replay and Diagnostics
releases.summary: Adds deterministic HMI/event replay, correction-chain highlighting, cumulative bottle rotation, and generated-versus-custom comparison.
changes: Step by HMI or mechanical event.
Pause at reference rows.
Explain why each command was generated.
Detect program/map mismatches during replay.

releases.title: Machine-Family Grammar Profiles
releases.summary: Introduces independent grammar profiles for TopModul, Autocol, MultiModul, TopMatic, APL, and Cold Glue.
changes: Annotate rows and mechanical events with correction-chain IDs.
Display active machine grammar in Validation and Mechanical Timeline.

releases.title: Unified Staging Application Shell
releases.summary: Establishes the recovered staging shell, same-window updater, aligned cache identifiers, and stable application loading.
changes: Remove recursive version observer behavior.
Load published staging assets through one authoritative shell.
Preserve browser maps and specification libraries during recovery.
